name: Barnsdall Junior Arts Center Gallery
about_text: Barnsdall Junior Arts Center (BJAC) Gallery is a public exhibition space within Barnsdall Art Park, operated by the City of Los Angeles Department of Cultural Affairs (DCA). It is part of a cluster of facilities that also includes the Barnsdall Arts Center (BAC) and the Junior Arts Center itself, all located at 4814 Hollywood Blvd. in Los Angeles. As a civic institution, the gallery's programming is guided by DCA's values framework emphasizing inclusion, diversity, equity, excellence, and access, aiming to deliver arts and cultural programming as a public service to residents and visitors of Los Angeles.
hours_text: Monday – Friday: 9:00am – 5:30pm; Closed all official City holidays
